description: Check a domain's DKIM public keys in DNS. With a selector (the s= tag of a DKIM-Signature header), checks that selector's key; without one, probes common selector names. Finding no key on common names does not prove DKIM is missing: selectors cannot be listed from DNS.

selector.description: DKIM selector, for example google or selector1. Leave out to probe common selectors.

name: check_dkim
title: DKIM check
